_help: Paid spots, shown in a box marked Sponsored. Each entry gives one of: route (a listed route's slug), school (a schools-directory slug) or url + name (any other advertiser; optional text and country). Then start and end (dates like 2026-12-01, at most 31 days apart) and, optionally, placements (any of home, board, country; all three if left out). A spot shows only between its dates.
